note: Telegram is the only support and outreach channel. Each template is a ready-to-paste Arabic message; the deep link opens the chat picker with the text already filled in, so a human reviews and sends. Copy is truthful and never claims existing customers or unverifiable results.
agent_count_note: Do not hard-code an agent count in copy. The live number is served from src/services/catalog.py and rendered on the landing page.
